question: I need to add funds to my Wix Payments account in order to issue a refund. Can you guide me on how to do this?

4. Enter the amount you wish to refund (and optionally add a note).
5. If needed, click "Add Funds & Complete Refund" to add funds to your account.
6. Enter your credit/debit card details and confirm by clicking "Yes, Refund".

question: I want to know how to transfer the edited page from the copy version to my original site without overwriting the original page.
answer:
To transfer the edited page from the copy version to your original site, you can follow these steps:

1. Go back to your original site and click on "Site" at the top of the editor.
2. Click "Duplicate Site".
3. Give a name to the duplicate site (e.g., "Test Site").
4. In your editor, click "Site" again.
5. Select the section that you want to transfer from the copy version.
6. Click "Copy Link" or "Link" next to the selected section.
7. Go back to your original site and enter the URL of the copied page (e.g., [www.example.com/page_name]).
8. In your editor, click on the "Site Actions" icon > "Copy Link" or "Link".
9. This will create a link to the copied page on your original site.
10. You can then paste this link into other sites in your account where you want to insert the copied page.

By doing it this way, you can transfer edited pages from one copy version of a site to another without overwriting the original page.
